profile.headline: Retired!
profile.summary:
Seeking to apply my expertise, my passion and work ethics within a Computer Science environment in a challenging and responsible position, which will allow and encourage full utilization of formal academic training, valuable hands-on experience, ambition and commitment to excellence and my ability to learn new technologies quickly due to my combined skills set of knowing both the administration end and applications on many different platforms.

Specialties: Apache, Assembly, C, Cacti, CUPS, Software Debugging, DEC PDP/VAX/Alpha, Develop Device Drivers, Fortran, HP Servers & Workstations, HTML, Image Processing, Java, Javascript, LDAP, Leadership, Linux, YUM repositories, Mac, Windows, MySQL, Nagios, Networking, NFS, NIS, Oracle RAC, OSSEC, PHP, RSYNC, Perl, SAMBA, Scientific Programming, SGI, Shell Scripting, Software Development, Solaris, Sun Servers, System Admin, Unix, User Interface Design, VAX/VMS, Web Site design, Wise, Vmware, VSphere

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and supported in-house Backupatron Xtreme and EMC AppSync snapshot capabilities including multigeneration copies and AppSync upgrades. Developed PowerShell scripts to perform XtremeIO 1st and 2nd generation snapshots to utilize multiple copies of environments that would have not been possible without greatly increasing the storage footprint. Played a role in monitoring, managing and capacity planning of company’s storage needs. Developed scripts to gather and populate VMware storage tables with capacity, usage, free space and other necessary data that is no longer available directly from VMware’s database views. Worked with others on the team to help identify weakness and plans for security moving forward.

positions.title: SAAS Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Provided the oversight and management of ensuring that the CostGuard SaaS Platform meets the agreed upon service level targets. Played a proactive role in monitoring and managing key performance metrics striving to deliver the best possible service to our customers. Proactively monitor and troubleshoot platform capacity and performance issues working in conjunction with the other business units to enable high quality and timely solutions. Deployed and configured various integral components of the SaaS Platform including determining impact of change requests to the system and coordinating with the implementation teams for customer transition to new software/services. Wrote various Linux and PowerShell scripts for automation and monitoring. Planned, configured and managed Window System Servers and application specific servers and storage and networking within Azure Cloud Services.

positions.title: Linux Engineer
positions.description: Concentrated on Security and Identity Management.  Standardized SUDO configuration across all Linux servers.  Implemented role based security.  Developed  SUDO and OSSEC runbook documents.  I made the OSSEC more useable to better monitor the Linux servers for integrity and intrusion detection and the ability to perform server forensics.  Enhanced the ‘Change Notice System’ with a Web interface and the ability to sort and search change notices to make it more accessible to management.  Performed system engineering tasks that needed to be addressed.  Provided Senior level Linux support.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Contracted to design, build, install and configure Red Hat and Solaris servers & workstations to support existing and new infrastructure.  Unix and Linux troubleshooting using bash scripting as well as NIS and NFS environment maintenance. Maintained and implemented upgrades as well as managed and automated recurring tasks. Optimize systems for best performance, lowest latency.  Handled day to day issues for the Linux environment.  Supported networking infrastructure.  EMC storage system, NFS, quotas.  Implemented Nagios and Cacti monitoring systems.  Impletmented OSSEC secuitry monitoring.  Supported a smooth transition and knowledge transfer of the previous support IT oganization, comprised of data centers and user base in various buildings.  Developed different scripts and procedures to automate and migrate users, putting the project days ahead of schedule.

positions.title: Linux Engineer
positions.description: Contracted to implement transition to a Linux VMware environment running Red Hat Enterprise Linux with Oracle RAC.  Instrumental in building an efficient Linux team with customer focus.  Set up BMC Patrol Agents to monitor systems remotely.   Supported a smooth transition and knowledge transfer of operations to HCL Technologies.  Trained HCL personnel to support Constellation Brands servers and desktops. Documented the environment and wrote system maintenance and operational procedures.  Supported Data Center move from the Canandaigua Data Center to the New Jersey Data Center.  Handled support issues for the Linux environment and provided on call 24/7 support.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst
positions.description: Received Achievement Award for developing programs and scripts using Linux and Unix command-line and shell programming to automate, secure and harden of Sun Solaris and Linux systems.  Performed analysis, planning and implementation for system and infrastructure needs, projects and network issues on Sun servers and workstations (Sun OS, Solaris 8, 9, 10), Red Hat Linux servers and workstations, Windows 2003 servers and Windows XP Professional workstations and DEC Alpha (DEC Unix) with Unigraphics, Nastran and Patran applications. Programming for different system applications, scripting, developed WISE software packages, developed and implemented Altiris applications.  Instrumental in bringing the help desk problem tracking system online. Solved year long Mail system problems. Maintained C&GS intranet web site using Apache Web Server, Java, JavaScript, MySQL, HTML and Perl. Showed leadership to the rest of group by being a mentor.

company.name: ITT Geospatial Systems & Eastman Kodak Company

positions.title: Systems Analyst / Software Engineer
positions.description: Provided support to various customers on several different platforms. They include Sun (Sun OS, Solaris), HP, SGI, DEC Alpha, Macintosh and PC's running Windows (95, 3.1, NT). Consolidated functions implemented RDCS standards and Corporate Security standards. Provided consulting for system needs, applications, projects and network issues. Implemented Backup strategies; Provided customer support for Kodak Photo CD products on Macintosh and Unix platforms.  Supported Macintosh and Unix photo CD developer tool kits, utilizing C Programming language in Think C and MPW developing environments, as well as various Macintosh debugging tools. Configured, installed and maintained the Marketing Technical Support (MTS) Sun Unix server for MTS and D&AIMS. Provided training for customers and Kodak support personnel for Photo CD portfolio, emphasizing Sun's Build-It product. This included not only training of the product but also teaching of the Unix operating system. Supported Kodak Photo CD on World Wide Web; Worked on a major development project writing software for a user interface and forms management system. Provided software for inter process communications and low level I/O and various conversion routines. Primarily VAX/VMS based utilizing FORTRAN 77, C and Macro assembly language.  Wrote device drivers and interfaces for realtime applications. Accountable for problem resolutions at both the system and application level. Supported and provided systems maintenance for in excess of 200 end users.
